name: Pivot
blurb: A pre-revenue founder in a fleece vest on a carbon e-bike, pitching mid-race to nobody.

meta.notes: San Francisco local (playtest 1c), the tone guide's "tech-bro rivals on e-bikes". A showboat at heart; M2 has only the racer and heavy-hitter presets, so he is a racer with a high weave and risk-taking: he takes the stair alley, jumps every crest and hits whoever is winning. He rides the base starter bike until an e-bike lands.
